evidence_rules: Injected VAD decisions prove segmentation only. Native fixture checks and real-call behavior are separate evidence.

cases.given: Agent is speaking; caller begins real speech lasting at least 60 ms of native voiced evidence.
cases.expect: VAD started cancels generation and queued local output before submitting the finished user utterance to STT.
cases.acceptance: No old response frames are sent after local cancellation; already transmitted remote audio cannot be claimed cleared.

cases.given: One 30 ms window is voiced, followed by silence.
cases.expect: No utterance start, no STT submission, no spurious barge-in.

cases.given: Caller speaks then native classification becomes continuously silent.
cases.expect: End after five complete silent 60 ms frames; retain up to 120 ms preroll and trailing silence. Native classifier hangover must be measured separately.

cases.given: Caller pauses for 240 ms of classified silence and resumes speech.
cases.expect: Preserve one utterance and reset endpoint silence counter.

cases.given: Native classifier continues indicating speech beyond 20 seconds.
cases.expect: Emit a bounded segment within 20 seconds; future segments never retain completed-turn audio.

cases.given: An ended utterance is queued and STT exceeds its deadline.
cases.expect: Surface a controlled runtime failure, release the segment, keep media receive bounded, and do not fabricate recognized speech.

cases.given: Media ends before sufficient voiced evidence starts an utterance.
cases.expect: Discard the candidate without starting work or leaking its audio into another call.

cases.given: One call is speaking while another is silent.
cases.expect: Each call uses its own VAD and buffers; silent call cannot inherit the speaking call's start or segment.
